Key Responsibilities Lead root-cause investigations into schedule and delivery issues and ensure they are closed with tangible outcomes rather than status updates. Own and drive actions recorded within the EPMO Tasks & Issues Log. Escalate delegation-of-authority and signatory-bloat findings immediately upon identification. Represent the EPMO in entity-level delivery review forums. Ability to review and interpret project schedules (Primavera P6 or equivalent) and distinguish genuine critical-path slippage from float erosion or reporting artefacts. Deep understanding of delay causation, including contractor underperformance, design/IFC delays, procurement or payment blockages, client-side issues, and force majeure events. Ability to substantiate findings through documentation and evidence rather than relying solely on stakeholder narratives. Practical understanding of GC and subcontractor delivery chains, including situations where both entities operate within the same group. Experience & Technical Skills 10-15 years of experience in major project delivery environments. Familiarity with holding-company and subsidiary delivery structures. Proven experience holding senior stakeholders, including CEOs, COOs, and Project Directors, accountable in delivery and governance forums. Experience managing construction disputes or delivery escalations through to resolution, even if not acting in a legal capacity. AI Fluency (Non-Negotiable) Genuine enthusiasm for leveraging AI as a core professional tool through real-world examples rather than general awareness of AI platforms. Experience using AI to identify delivery risks earlier, accelerate root-cause analysis, or support recovery planning. Ability to explain practical examples of AI-driven improvements to project delivery outcomes. Comfort working with technical teams to develop AI-assisted solutions for schedule and delivery analysis, even without direct software development expertise. Persistent and comfortable challenging the closure of issues when evidence does not support resolution. Firm, objective, and evidence-based in approach rather than confrontational.
